newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn warns Afghan Taleban on human rights.
newsitem.headline: Bonn warns Afghan Taleban on human rights.

text.p: Germany on Thursday urged Afghanistan's radical Islamic Taleban militia to respect basic principles of human decency and warned it would get no cooperation from Bonn if it trampled on women's rights.
Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said the Taleban had provoked horror worldwide since they conquered Kabul last month.
"Since then the situation for women has deteriorated further," Kinkel said in a statement.
Under the Taleban's ideosyncratic version of fundamentalist Islam, women have been told to stay at home, not work and appear completely veiled in public. Girls schools have also been closed.
Kinkel called on the Taleban to work with the United Nations envoy in Afghanistan, German diplomat Norbert Holl.
"Any Afghan government which tramples on human rights, especially the basic rights of women, will not be able to count on cooperation with Germany," the minister said.
